actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 396 - 15 (Roll no. 44). (text: CR H739)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 396 - 15 (Roll no. 44). (text: CR H739)
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H749)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 832.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H739-740)
Mr. Williams (TX) moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Referred to the House Committee on Small Business.

dimensions.assessment: Affects small businesses engaged in international trade and regulatory matters, as well as the operations of the Office of Advocacy.
dimensions.evidence: represent the views and interests of small businesses before foreign governments and international entities

dimensions.assessment: Administrative and representative expansion of agency functions rather than a sweeping regulatory or financial change.
dimensions.evidence: clarify the primary functions and duties of the Office of Advocacy of the Small Business Administration

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending levels or fiscal allocations are mentioned in the source material.
Amends Public Law 94-305 to add specific international duties to an existing office.
dimensions.evidence: Section 203(a) of Public Law 94-305... is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent statutory responsibilities for the Office of Advocacy.
dimensions.evidence: by adding at the end the following... represent the views and interests of small businesses

missing_information: Any potential budgetary changes required to support these additional duties are not stated.
importance_detail.rationale: Expands the duties of the Small Business Administration's Office of Advocacy to include examining international economy roles and representing small business interests before foreign and international entities.
